_meta.title: FLUX 3 Klein (distilled int8; base: flux3-image-klein-base-int8-convrot, 50 steps, cfg 3.5)

inputs.string_a: Film character sheet, photorealistic commercial studio photography, one seamless neutral grey #B8B8B8 background, seven panels side by side separated by thin light grey lines. The four narrow panels on the left are full-body views of the exact same person, feet to head fully in frame: front view facing the camera, three-quarter view, side profile view, back view. The three wider panels on the right are close-up portraits of the same person from the chest up: facing the camera straight on; head turned about 45 degrees to the side so one cheek is closer to the camera (a true three-quarter view, both eyes visible but the far eye partly hidden by the nose bridge); and a full side profile at 90 degrees. Identical person, face, hairstyle, outfit and styling in all seven panels.

inputs.string_b: Relaxed neutral standing pose in the full-body views, arms loose at the sides, head level. In the close-ups the face is fully visible and sharp, eyes in focus, natural relaxed expression, clear healthy skin, true-to-life skin texture. Soft even studio lighting with smooth falloff, clean commercial catalogue look, crisp fabric and hair detail. No text, no labels, no captions, no numbers, no lettering anywhere.
